title: hieracium lachenalii subsp. subaustrinum
intro: Hieracium lachenalii subsp. subaustrinum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a flowering plant species within the dandelion family. It is traditionally used to treat a variety of health issues, including respiratory problems, due to its anti-inflammatory properties and ability to reduce mucus production, making it beneficial for conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Hawkweed include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which work together to soothe irritated tissues and promote the clearance of mucus from the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of Hawkweed include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used in traditional herbal remedies.
